Existing RDA object identifiers are retained for compatibility. Mplus folders,
run-file prefixes, reports, tables and figures use the current analysis numbering.

# Purpose

This report uses the Mplus 8.7 `DIFFTEST` function to compare the two nested
baseline Trait PSMU CFA models from S2.2.1: the more restrictive one-factor B1
model and the less restrictive correlated Core--Peripheral B2 model. The 18
indicators are treated as ordered categorical with WLSMV and Delta
parameterization, exactly as in S2.2.1. The DIFFTEST result is parsed through R
`MplusAutomation` and embedded directly in this HTML report; no Excel or CSV
result file is created.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
locate_project_root <- function(start = getwd()) {
  current <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
  if (!dir.exists(current)) current <- dirname(current)
  repeat {
    if (all(dir.exists(file.path(current, c(
      "Step_1_Descriptive_and_Reliability", "Step_2_Measurement_Models"
    ))))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (identical(parent, current)) break
    current <- parent
  }
  stop("Could not locate the project from its public Step directories")
}

load_single_object <- function(path, expected_name) {
  environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  loaded <- load(path, envir = environment)
  if (!identical(loaded, expected_name)) {
    stop(
      "Expected ", expected_name, " in ", path,
      "; found: ", paste(loaded, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  environment[[expected_name]]
}
```

# Load and validate the baseline item data

```{r load-and-validate-inputs}
dat_step2_measurement <- load_single_object(
  measurement_file,
  "dat_step2_measurement"
)
fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv <- load_single_object(
  s2_2_1_result_file,
  "fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv"
)

baseline_items <- paste0("V_BSMAS_", 1:18)
required_columns <- c("Name_ID", baseline_items)
dat_baseline_cfa <- dat_step2_measurement$baseline |>
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(required_columns)) |>
  as.data.frame()

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(dat_step2_measurement),
    c("baseline", "ema", "item_map", "audit")
  ),
  nrow(dat_step2_measurement$baseline) == 209L,
  ncol(dat_step2_measurement$baseline) == 43L,
  nrow(dat_step2_measurement$item_map) == 48L,
  identical(names(dat_baseline_cfa), required_columns),
  nrow(dat_baseline_cfa) == 209L,
  dplyr::n_distinct(dat_baseline_cfa$Name_ID) == 209L,
  !anyNA(dat_baseline_cfa),
  all(vapply(
    dat_baseline_cfa[baseline_items],
    function(x) all(x %in% 1:5),
    logical(1)
  )),
  identical(
    fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv$metadata$input_md5,
    unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file))
  ),
  identical(
    fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv$metadata$mplus_version,
    "8.7"
  ),
  identical(
    fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv$metadata$estimator,
    "WLSMV"
  ),
  all(fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv$diagnostics$normal_termination)
)

category_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(baseline_items, function(item) {
  counts <- table(factor(dat_baseline_cfa[[item]], levels = 1:5))
  data.frame(
    item = item,
    categories_observed = sum(counts > 0L),
    smallest_category_n = min(counts),
    largest_category_n = max(counts),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
stopifnot(
  all(category_audit$categories_observed == 5L),
  all(category_audit$smallest_category_n > 0L)
)

input_audit <- data.frame(
  participants = nrow(dat_baseline_cfa),
  items = length(baseline_items),
  missing_item_cells = sum(is.na(dat_baseline_cfa[baseline_items])),
  minimum_response = min(as.matrix(dat_baseline_cfa[baseline_items])),
  maximum_response = max(as.matrix(dat_baseline_cfa[baseline_items])),
  measurement_rda_md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(input_audit)
knitr::kable(category_audit)
```

# Generate the nested model pair

The less restrictive B2 model is run first and writes the derivative
information file. The more restrictive B1 model is then run with that file in
the `ANALYSIS: DIFFTEST = ...;` option. Both models use identical data, variable
order, categorical declarations, estimator, and parameterization.

```{r define-models}
mplus_item_names <- paste0("bs", 1:18)
mplus_data <- dat_baseline_cfa[baseline_items]
names(mplus_data) <- mplus_item_names
mplus_data <- as.data.frame(mplus_data)

model_syntax <- list(
  B1_OneFactor = "trait BY bs1-bs18;",
  B2_CorePeripheral = paste(
    "periph BY bs1-bs6;",
    "core BY bs7-bs18;",
    "periph WITH core;",
    sep = "\n"
  )
)

diff_file_name <- "s2_3_b1_vs_b2.dif"
model_specs <- list(
  H1 = list(
    model_id = "B2_CorePeripheral",
    stem = "s2_3_b1_vs_b2_h1_b2_core_peripheral",
    role = "Less restrictive H1",
    savadata = TRUE
  ),
  H0 = list(
    model_id = "B1_OneFactor",
    stem = "s2_3_b1_vs_b2_h0_b1_one_factor",
    role = "More restrictive H0",
    savadata = FALSE
  )
)

model_plan <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(model_specs), function(role) {
  specification <- model_specs[[role]]
  data.frame(
    role = role,
    model_id = specification$model_id,
    nesting_role = specification$role,
    estimator = "WLSMV",
    parameterization = "DELTA",
    categorical_items = 18L,
    input_file = paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

knitr::kable(model_plan)
```

```{r run-mplus-difftest}
run_baseline_model <- function(role, specification) {
  data_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".dat"))
  input_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".inp"))
  output_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, paste0(specification$stem, ".out"))

  analysis_syntax <- paste(
    "ESTIMATOR = WLSMV;",
    "PARAMETERIZATION = DELTA;",
    if (role == "H0") paste0("DIFFTEST = ", diff_file_name, ";") else "",
    sep = "\n"
  )
  object_arguments <- list(
    TITLE = paste(
      "! Author: Kunru Song",
      paste0("S2.3 ", role, " ", specification$model_id, " baseline CFA DIFFTEST;"),
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    VARIABLE = "CATEGORICAL = bs1-bs18;",
    ANALYSIS = analysis_syntax,
    MODEL = model_syntax[[specification$model_id]],
    OUTPUT = paste(
      "STANDARDIZED(STDYX);",
      "CINTERVAL;",
      "TECH1;",
      "TECH4;",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    usevariables = mplus_item_names,
    rdata = mplus_data,
    autov = FALSE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  if (role == "H1") {
    object_arguments$SAVEDATA <- paste0("DIFFTEST = ", diff_file_name, ";")
  }

  mplus_object <- do.call(MplusAutomation::mplusObject, object_arguments)
  MplusAutomation::mplusModeler(
    object = mplus_object,
    dataout = data_path,
    modelout = input_path,
    run = 1L,
    check = FALSE,
    varwarnings = TRUE,
    Mplus_command = mplus_command,
    writeData = "always",
    hashfilename = FALSE,
    killOnFail = TRUE,
    quiet = TRUE
  )

  stopifnot(file.exists(data_path), file.exists(input_path), file.exists(output_path))
  input_lines <- readLines(input_path, warn = FALSE)
  output_lines <- readLines(output_path, warn = FALSE)
  parsed <- MplusAutomation::readModels(output_path, what = "all", quiet = TRUE)

  checks <- list(
    author_present = any(trimws(input_lines) == "! Author: Kunru Song"),
    categorical_declared = any(grepl(
      "CATEGORICAL\\s*=\\s*bs1-bs18;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    wlsmv_declared = any(grepl(
      "ESTIMATOR\\s*=\\s*WLSMV;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    delta_declared = any(grepl(
      "PARAMETERIZATION\\s*=\\s*DELTA;",
      input_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE,
      perl = TRUE
    )),
    difftest_requested = any(grepl("DIFFTEST", input_lines, fixed = TRUE)),
    normal_termination = any(grepl(
      "THE MODEL ESTIMATION TERMINATED NORMALLY",
      output_lines,
      fixed = TRUE
    )),
    no_fatal_error = !any(grepl("*** ERROR", output_lines, fixed = TRUE)),
    local_unavailable_warning_absent = !any(grepl(
      "not available",
      output_lines,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ))
  )

  stopifnot(
    all(unlist(checks)),
    identical(as.character(parsed$summaries$Mplus.version), "8.7"),
    is.list(parsed)
  )

  list(
    role = role,
    model_id = specification$model_id,
    paths = c(data = data_path, input = input_path, output = output_path),
    input_lines = input_lines,
    output_lines = output_lines,
    parsed = parsed,
    checks = checks
  )
}

# The derivative file belongs to the less restrictive H1 model and is replaced
# reproducibly on every run.
diff_file_path <- file.path(mplus_directory, diff_file_name)
if (file.exists(diff_file_path)) {
  unlink(diff_file_path, force = TRUE)
}

h1_result <- run_baseline_model("H1", model_specs$H1)
stopifnot(file.exists(diff_file_path), file.info(diff_file_path)$size > 0)
h0_result <- run_baseline_model("H0", model_specs$H0)
stopifnot(file.exists(diff_file_path), file.info(diff_file_path)$size > 0)
```

# Extract the Mplus DIFFTEST result

```{r extract-difftest-result}
extract_section_number <- function(lines, header_index, label) {
  block <- lines[header_index:min(length(lines), header_index + 15L)]
  matching <- grep(
    paste0("^\\s*", label, "\\s+[-+0-9.Ee]+\\*?\\s*$"),
    block,
    value = TRUE,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  if (length(matching) != 1L) {
    stop("Could not uniquely parse ", label, " from DIFFTEST output section.")
  }
  as.numeric(sub(
    paste0("^\\s*", label, "\\s+([-+0-9.Ee]+).*$"),
    "\\1",
    matching,
    perl = TRUE
  ))
}

header_index <- grep(
  "Chi-Square Test for Difference Testing",
  h0_result$output_lines,
  fixed = TRUE
)
if (length(header_index) != 1L) {
  stop("Mplus output must contain one Chi-Square Test for Difference Testing section.")
}

difftest_value <- extract_section_number(
  h0_result$output_lines,
  header_index,
  "Value"
)
difftest_df <- extract_section_number(
  h0_result$output_lines,
  header_index,
  "Degrees of Freedom"
)
difftest_p <- extract_section_number(
  h0_result$output_lines,
  header_index,
  "P-Value"
)

difftest_result <- data.frame(
  comparison = "B1 one factor vs B2 correlated Core-Peripheral",
  more_restrictive_h0 = "B1_OneFactor",
  less_restrictive_h1 = "B2_CorePeripheral",
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  parameterization = "DELTA",
  participants = 209L,
  difference_chi_square = difftest_value,
  difference_df = as.integer(difftest_df),
  p_value = difftest_p,
  conclusion = ifelse(
    difftest_p < .05,
    "B2 fits significantly better than B1",
    "No significant nested-model improvement"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(difftest_result) == 1L,
  is.finite(difftest_result$difference_chi_square),
  difftest_result$difference_chi_square >= 0,
  difftest_result$difference_df == 1L,
  difftest_result$p_value >= 0,
  difftest_result$p_value <= 1,
  difftest_result$p_value < .05
)

difftest_display <- difftest_result |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    difference_chi_square = round(difference_chi_square, 3),
    p_value = format.pval(p_value, digits = 4, eps = .0001)
  )

knitr::kable(difftest_display)
```

The Mplus-adjusted WLSMV DIFFTEST rejects the more restrictive one-factor model
in favor of the correlated Core--Peripheral model. This improvement in relative fit does not resolve the poor absolute fit documented for B2 in S2.2.1.

```{r validation-checks, include=FALSE}
model_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(
  list(H1 = h1_result, H0 = h0_result),
  function(result) {
    data.frame(
      role = result$role,
      model_id = result$model_id,
      author_present = result$checks$author_present,
      categorical_declared = result$checks$categorical_declared,
      wlsmv_declared = result$checks$wlsmv_declared,
      delta_declared = result$checks$delta_declared,
      difftest_requested = result$checks$difftest_requested,
      normal_termination = result$checks$normal_termination,
      no_fatal_error = result$checks$no_fatal_error,
      output_file = basename(result$paths[["output"]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
))

generated_model_files <- c(h1_result$paths, h0_result$paths)
validation_checks <- data.frame(
  check = c(
    "S2.1 and S2.2.1 input hashes match",
    "H1 derivative-information file exists",
    "Both Mplus inputs contain the exact author text",
    "Both inputs use categorical WLSMV with Delta parameterization",
    "Both Mplus models terminated normally without fatal errors",
    "H0 output contains one DIFFTEST section",
    "The extracted DIFFTEST has one degree of freedom",
    "All generated Mplus audit files exist"
  ),
  passed = c(
    identical(
      fit_s2_2_1_baseline_cfa_wlsmv$metadata$input_md5,
      unname(tools::md5sum(measurement_file))
    ),
    file.exists(diff_file_path) && file.info(diff_file_path)$size > 0,
    all(model_audit$author_present),
    all(
      model_audit$categorical_declared &
        model_audit$wlsmv_declared &
        model_audit$delta_declared
    ),
    all(model_audit$normal_termination & model_audit$no_fatal_error),
    length(header_index) == 1L,
    difftest_result$difference_df == 1L,
    all(file.exists(generated_model_files))
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(validation_checks$passed)) {
  stop(
    "S2.3 validation failed: ",
    paste(validation_checks$check[!validation_checks$passed], collapse = "; ")
  )
}
```
